functions.name: inject
functions.description: Add label chips to the message list cards of a mail tab.

functions.name: setColors
functions.description: Set label colors as { serverKey: { labelName: { bg, fg } } } plus a '*' entry for overrides, and refresh all lists.

functions.name: listGmailServers
functions.description: List incoming Gmail IMAP servers as [{ key, accountId, username }].

functions.name: getAccessToken
functions.description: Get an OAuth access token for a Gmail server, using Thunderbird's stored login.

functions.name: addLabel
functions.description: Record a label on messages locally, so their chips update without waiting for a re-download.

functions.name: removeLabel
functions.description: Remove a label recorded on messages locally, so their chips update without waiting for a re-download.

functions.name: getLabels
functions.description: Get the user labels recorded on each message (not counting the label of the folder it's in).

functions.name: listLabelNames
functions.description: List the Gmail label names (IMAP folders) of a server.
